content.value: The star-connected rotor of an induction motor has a standstill impedance of (0.4+j4) Ω per phase and the rheostat impedance per phase is (6+j2) Ω. The motor has an induced emf of 80 V between slip rings at standstill when connected to its normal supply voltage. Find (i) rotor current at standstill with the rheostat is in the circuit and (ii) when the sliprings are short-circuited and motor is running at 3% slip.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
